name: 黑枸杞 (Black goji berry)
description: Turns a striking purple-blue colour, mildly sweet and earthy. A wellness staple.
pairs: 菊花, dried lemon zest, goji berries.

name: 桂花 (Osmanthus)
description: Delicate apricot-like floral sweetness, very popular in Chinese tea culture.
pairs: Light oolong, 菊花, honey in the cup.

name: Dried rose buds
description: Subtle and elegant, gentle warmth. Different from rosehip — this is the flower, not the fruit.
pairs: Dried lychee, light black tea base, honey in the cup.

name: Lavender
description: Aromatic and calming, good for an evening flask.
pairs: Robust black tea base, dried lemon zest.

name: Butterfly pea flower (蝶豆花)
description: Vivid blue colour that shifts to purple with citrus. Mild and earthy on its own.
pairs: Dried lemon zest or lemongrass, honey in the cup.

name: Lemon verbena
description: Bright, lemony and refreshing. Less intense than lemongrass.

name: Rosehip
description: The fruit of the rose plant — tart, fruity, vitamin C rich. Completely different from rosebud which is the flower. Very robust to long steeping.

name: Toasted rice
description: Mild and grounding, genmaicha-adjacent without the green tea.
pairs: 菊花, dried ginger, a small amount of 绿茶 alongside.

name: Licorice root
description: Naturally intensely sweet without any sugar, very robust to long steeping.

name: Fennel seed
description: Mildly sweet and anise-like, traditionally used as a digestive aid.
pairs: Licorice root, dried ginger, dried lemon zest.
